The Digitreams edge — post-Andromeda playbook

Creative is the new targeting.

Meta's Andromeda update changed the game. The algorithm finds your buyers now — if you feed it the right creative and clean signals. Interest-stacking and narrow audiences are yesterday's playbook. Ours runs on three principles.

PRINCIPLE / 01

Creative diversity

Different hooks, formats and angles for different buyers — UGC, AI video, statics and carousels tested against each other, never one ad asked to do every job.

PRINCIPLE / 02

Broad targeting

Wide audiences with strong creative doing the filtering. The algorithm is better at finding buyers than manual interest lists ever were — we let it work.

PRINCIPLE / 03

Strong conversion signals

Clean pixel and Conversions API setup, qualified-lead feedback loops, and forms built to filter junk out — so the algorithm learns from buyers, not browsers.

    Straight answers

    Before you ask.

    A doctor's-report style diagnosis of your current marketing — what is broken, what it is costing you, and what to fix first — across your ad accounts, website and social presence. No prices or packages pushed inside it. At the end there is one soft offer — a free 15-minute call to walk through the findings together.

    No — and be careful with any agency that does. 4.5× is the average from our track record on Meta and TikTok, not a promise. What we do guarantee is the process — framework-based builds, customised AIDA copy, verified tracking, and honest reporting on cost per qualified result — never "cheap" numbers that don't convert.

    That is what the audit and the planner above help you decide. We pitch only the service your business actually needs, with the report to show why — never a blanket package. A business with traffic but no conversions needs a website fix before more ads; a business with no traffic needs the opposite order.

    Paid campaigns produce data within days, and the first optimisation decisions happen in the first two weeks. Meaningful movement on cost per acquisition typically shows across the first full optimisation cycles. SEO and organic social are slower-burning channels and are planned as such — we will tell you the honest timeline for your case in the audit.

    Your campaigns are built and managed by a performance marketer with 15+ years of cross-industry experience — the same person who audits your account and walks you through the report. No hand-offs to juniors after the sale.
